label: ZKN_MOON_010_000
text:
It’s easy to catch, and it grows quickly, making
it one of the top recommendations for novice
Pokémon Trainers.

label: ZKN_MOON_011_000
text:
Its shell is hard, but it’s still just a bug shell.
It’s been known to break, so intense battles
with it should be avoided.

label: ZKN_MOON_012_000
text:
When attacked by other Pokémon, it defends
itself by scattering its poisonous scales and
fluttering its wings.

label: ZKN_MOON_019_000
text:
With their strong capacity for survival, they can
live in dirty places without concern. Left
unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.

label: ZKN_MOON_020_000
text:
Its disposition is far more violent than its looks
would suggest. Don’t let your hand get too close
to its face, as it could bite your hand clean off.

label: ZKN_MOON_021_000
text:
Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug
Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous
appetite and look after it.

label: ZKN_MOON_022_000
text:
Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can
be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.

label: ZKN_MOON_025_000
text:
It’s in its nature to store electricity. It feels
stressed now and then if it’s unable to fully
discharge the electricity.

label: ZKN_MOON_026_000
text:
It becomes aggressive when it has electricity
stored up. At such times, even its Trainer has to
take care to avoid being attacked.

label: ZKN_MOON_027_000
text:
It usually makes its home in deserts and arid
zones, where rain does not fall. It digs holes to
catch Bug-type Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_028_000
text:
It uses its claws to climb trees and then curls
its body into a spiny ball, ready to drop onto
any prey that appears.

label: ZKN_MOON_035_000
text:
On nights with a full moon, they gather together
and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped
in an abnormal magnetic field.

label: ZKN_MOON_036_000
text:
According to tradition, people who see a pair
of Clefable skipping by can look forward to a
happy marriage.

label: ZKN_MOON_037_000
text:
From its mouth spew flames that seem to
resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some
people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.

label: ZKN_MOON_038_000
text:
Said to live for a thousand years, this Pokémon
uses its supernatural abilities to manipulate fire.
It can burn its prey to a crisp as it pleases.

label: ZKN_MOON_039_000
text:
Jigglypuff possess a vocal range that exceeds
12 octaves, but each individual’s singing skill
depends on its own effort.

label: ZKN_MOON_040_000
text:
As it inhales, it expands...and expands...and
expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one
can inflate itself the most.

label: ZKN_MOON_041_000
text:
When exposed to sunlight, they suffer burns.
The frequency of their ultrasonic waves can
differ slightly from colony to colony.

label: ZKN_MOON_042_000
text:
Sometimes they drink so much blood, they can’t
fly anymore. Then they fall to the ground and
become food for other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_046_000
text:
Mushrooms called tochukaso sprout from its
back. They can be dried and powdered to make
a medicine used to extend life.

label: ZKN_MOON_047_000
text:
It scatters toxic spores from its mushroom cap.
Once harvested, these spores can be steeped
and boiled down to prepare herbal medicines.

label: ZKN_MOON_050_000
text:
Many farmers cherish and nurture Diglett
because its droppings enrich the soil it lives in.

label: ZKN_MOON_051_000
text:
Despite the closeness between this Pokémon
and farmers and other people, no one has ever
seen the parts of it concealed underground.

label: ZKN_MOON_052_000
text:
It loves shiny things. It often fights with
Murkrow over prey they’re both trying to catch.

label: ZKN_MOON_053_000
text:
It has a high opinion of itself, although not to
the same extent as the Alolan Persian. It’s quite
difficult to make friends with this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_054_000
text:
This Pokémon is troubled by constant
headaches. The more pain it’s in, the more
powerful its psychokinesis becomes.

label: ZKN_MOON_055_000
text:
It swims along the banks of lakes and catches
fish Pokémon. It takes them to the shore and
quietly eats them up.

label: ZKN_MOON_056_000
text:
Its raging tires it out and causes it to fall asleep,
but the anger resonating in its dreams causes it
to wake up—which infuriates it all over again.

label: ZKN_MOON_057_000
text:
Some researchers theorize that Primeape
remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

label: ZKN_MOON_058_000
text:
It looks cute, but when you approach another
Trainer’s Growlithe, it will bark at you and bite.

label: ZKN_MOON_059_000
text:
The fire burning inside its body serves as the
energy to fuel it as it runs great distances.
It appears in many legends.

label: ZKN_MOON_060_000
text:
It’s still not very good at walking. Its Trainers
should train this Pokémon to walk every day.

label: ZKN_MOON_061_000
text:
It marches over the land in search of bug
Pokémon to eat. Then it takes them underwater
so it can dine on them where it’s safe.

label: ZKN_MOON_062_000
text:
Its percentage of body fat is nearly zero. Its
body is entirely muscle, which makes it heavy
and forces its swimming prowess to develop.

label: ZKN_MOON_063_000
text:
It can teleport itself to safety while it’s asleep,
but when it wakes, it doesn’t know where it is,
so it panics.

label: ZKN_MOON_064_000
text:
Kadabra’s presence infests televisions and
monitors with creepy shadows that bring
bad luck.

label: ZKN_MOON_065_000
text:
Its brain cells continue to increase in number
until its death. The older the Alakazam, the
larger its head.

label: ZKN_MOON_066_000
text:
With its superhuman strength, it’s able to throw
a hundred people all at the same time. Its
strength comes from lifting Graveler every day.

label: ZKN_MOON_067_000
text:
It willingly assists with hard labor because it
knows the work is good training for its muscles.

label: ZKN_MOON_068_000
text:
It can lift heavy loads with the greatest of ease.
It can even heft dump trucks. But its clumsy
fingers prevent it from doing any precision work.

label: ZKN_MOON_072_000
text:
It drifts in shallow seas, such as the areas near
beaches. If you get bitten or stabbed by its
toxic tentacles, rush to the hospital.

label: ZKN_MOON_073_000
text:
Although these Pokémon are rare, when a large
outbreak of them occurs, all fish Pokémon
disappear from the surrounding sea.

label: ZKN_MOON_074_000
text:
There are plenty of them to be found along any
road. A scholar with too much free time once
counted a hundred of them along a single route.

label: ZKN_MOON_075_000
text:
This slow-footed Pokémon moves by curling up
and rolling instead of walking. With enough
momentum, its speed can exceed 60 mph.

label: ZKN_MOON_076_000
text:
Once a year, this Pokémon molts, and its shed
shell returns to the soil. This process creates
enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.

label: ZKN_MOON_079_000
text:
Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke
tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

label: ZKN_MOON_080_000
text:
Whenever Shellder bites down hard on its tail,
it gives Slowbro a flash of inspiration...which it
forgets a moment later.

label: ZKN_MOON_081_000
text:
It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it
float through the air. Touching it while it’s eating
electricity will give you a full-body shock.

label: ZKN_MOON_082_000
text:
It has about three times the electrical power of
Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this
Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

label: ZKN_MOON_088_000
text:
It was born from sludge transformed by
exposure to X-rays from the moon. When its
internal load of germs decreases, it dies.

label: ZKN_MOON_089_000
text:
After recent environmental improvements, this
Pokémon is now hardly seen at all. People
speculate that it may go extinct at some point.

label: ZKN_MOON_090_000
text:
This Pokémon’s tongue is always hanging out.
It uses its tongue with great dexterity to dig up
sand from the seabed in its search for food.

label: ZKN_MOON_091_000
text:
Excavation of the tombs of ancient hunting
tribes has turned up many spears tipped with
spikes that had fallen off this Pokémon’s shell.

label: ZKN_MOON_092_000
text:
Although Gastly is barely visible, when it’s near,
a faint sweet smell lingers.

label: ZKN_MOON_093_000
text:
It fears the light and revels in the dark. It may
be on the verge of extinction in cities that stay
brightly lit at night.

label: ZKN_MOON_094_000
text:
It apparently wishes for a traveling companion.
Since it was once human itself, it tries to create
one by taking the lives of other humans.

label: ZKN_MOON_096_000
text:
It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes
friends with people, it may show them the most
delicious dreams it’s ever eaten.

label: ZKN_MOON_097_000
text:
As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets
fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams.
Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

label: ZKN_MOON_102_000
text:
Six of them together form a full-fledged
Pokémon. It’s often hunted by Crabrawler,
but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

label: ZKN_MOON_103_000
text:
When the time comes, one of its three heads
falls off. Before long, the fallen head grows into
an Exeggcute.

label: ZKN_MOON_104_000
text:
The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead
mother. According to some, it will evolve when
it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

label: ZKN_MOON_105_000
text:
This Pokémon is out for vengeance on its natural
enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like
boomerangs to try to take it down.

label: ZKN_MOON_113_000
text:
Not only are these Pokémon fast runners,
they’re also few in number, so anyone who finds
one must be lucky indeed.

label: ZKN_MOON_115_000
text:
The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly
three years. That is the only time the mother is
heard to cry wildly.

label: ZKN_MOON_118_000
text:
Spellbound by the length of its horn and the
beauty of its fins, many strange Trainers raise
Goldeen and nothing but Goldeen.

label: ZKN_MOON_119_000
text:
Trainers who are crazy for Seaking are divided
into horn enthusiasts and fin enthusiasts.
The two groups do not get along well.

label: ZKN_MOON_120_000
text:
This Pokémon gets nibbled on by Lumineon and
others. Thanks to its red core, it regenerates
fast, so it’s unconcerned by their snack attacks.

label: ZKN_MOON_121_000
text:
Its unusual body shape, reminiscent of abstract
art, led local people to spread rumors that this
Pokémon may be an invader from outer space.

label: ZKN_MOON_123_000
text:
While young, they live together deep in the
mountains, training themselves in how to fight
with their scythes and move at high speeds.

label: ZKN_MOON_125_000
text:
Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater
than the amount of electricity it eats.

label: ZKN_MOON_126_000
text:
When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all
over its body. It doesn’t calm down until its
opponent has burned to ash.

label: ZKN_MOON_127_000
text:
One solid blow from its horns is enough to split
apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola
is Vikavolt.

label: ZKN_MOON_128_000
text:
Although it’s known to be a fierce Pokémon,
Tauros in the Alola region are said to possess
a measure of calmness.

label: ZKN_MOON_129_000
text:
Its reckless leaps make it easy pickings for
predators. On the bright side, many Pokémon
enjoy longer life spans, thanks to Magikarp.

label: ZKN_MOON_130_000
text:
There are people who swear that any place
Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.

label: ZKN_MOON_131_000
text:
These Pokémon were once near extinction due
to poaching. Following protective regulations,
there is now an overabundance of them.

label: ZKN_MOON_132_000
text:
With its astonishing capacity for
metamorphosis, it can get along with anything.
It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

label: ZKN_MOON_133_000
text:
Current studies show it can evolve into an
incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_134_000
text:
Blending in with the water and erasing all signs
of its presence, it patiently waits for its prey,
fish Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_135_000
text:
When its fur stands on end, that’s a sign it’s
about to give off a jolt of electricity. Take care,
as sometimes lightning strikes next to it, too.

label: ZKN_MOON_136_000
text:
Its average body temperature is between 1,300
and 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. In its internal
flame sac, temperatures reach 3,000 degrees.

label: ZKN_MOON_137_000
text:
It can convert its body into digital data,
which enables it to enter cyberspace.

label: ZKN_MOON_142_000
text:
In ancient times, it ruled the skies. A widely
accepted theory is that it went extinct due to
a large meteor impact.

label: ZKN_MOON_143_000
text:
It eats nearly 900 pounds of food every day.
It starts nodding off while eating—and continues
to eat even while it’s asleep.

label: ZKN_MOON_147_000
text:
After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able
to pull one up and confirm its existence.

label: ZKN_MOON_148_000
text:
From time immemorial, it has been venerated by
agricultural peoples as an entity able to control
the weather.

label: ZKN_MOON_149_000
text:
Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon
at your peril, because it will smash everything
to smithereens before it’s satisfied.

label: ZKN_MOON_165_000
text:
They communicate with one another using bodily
fluids that give off odors. When they’re angry,
their odor smells sour.

label: ZKN_MOON_166_000
text:
In battle, it throws punches with all four arms.
The power of each individual blow is piddly,
so it aims to win by quantity rather than quality.

label: ZKN_MOON_167_000
text:
Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into
nets to catch fish Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_168_000
text:
It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth.
Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips
their bodily fluids at its leisure.

label: ZKN_MOON_169_000
text:
Silent and swift in its four-winged flight, it bites
down on its prey before they realize what’s
happening. In a heartbeat, it drains their blood.

label: ZKN_MOON_170_000
text:
It lives in the depths beyond the reach of
sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae
to communicate with others of its kind.

label: ZKN_MOON_171_000
text:
This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds
its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver
an electrical attack.

label: ZKN_MOON_172_000
text:
Despite this Pokémon’s cute appearance, those
who want to live with one should prepare to be
on the receiving end of its electric jolts.

label: ZKN_MOON_173_000
text:
Because of its silhouette, it’s believed to be a
star reborn. For some reason, it loves Minior.

label: ZKN_MOON_174_000
text:
It moves by bouncing along. As it moves a lot,
it sweats, and its body gives off a sweet aroma.

label: ZKN_MOON_185_000
text:
Apparently, the larger the green parts of this
Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It’s a
particular favorite among elderly people.

label: ZKN_MOON_186_000
text:
It’s the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl.
When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.

label: ZKN_MOON_196_000
text:
It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its
forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb
grows dull and dark.

label: ZKN_MOON_197_000
text:
With its black fur, it blends into the darkness.
It bides its time, and when prey appears, this
Pokémon goes for its throat, and then eats it.

label: ZKN_MOON_198_000
text:
Seen as a symbol of bad luck, it’s generally
disliked. Yet it gives presents—objects that
sparkle or shine—to Trainers it’s close to.

label: ZKN_MOON_199_000
text:
This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a
proverb still persists in some regions: “When in
doubt, ask Slowking.”

label: ZKN_MOON_200_000
text:
If you hear a sobbing sound emanating from a
vacant room, it’s undoubtedly a bit of mischief
from Misdreavus.

label: ZKN_MOON_209_000
text:
Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This
laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

label: ZKN_MOON_210_000
text:
More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted
on by young people amused at the contrast
between its looks and its attitude.

label: ZKN_MOON_212_000
text:
Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon
smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard
as steel.

label: ZKN_MOON_215_000
text:
It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can
slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a
scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.

label: ZKN_MOON_222_000
text:
Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its
head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own
branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

label: ZKN_MOON_225_000
text:
It has a generous habit of sharing its food with
people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging
around for more food.

label: ZKN_MOON_227_000
text:
Its metal body is sturdy, but it does rust rather
easily. So on rainy days, this Pokémon prefers
to stay put in its nest.

label: ZKN_MOON_233_000
text:
Porygon was updated to a new version in
readiness for planetary development. But that
dream remains unrealized as yet.

label: ZKN_MOON_235_000
text:
It draws symbols all over the place to mark its
territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls
are covered in graffiti.

label: ZKN_MOON_239_000
text:
This Pokémon is constantly fighting with
Togedemaru that try to steal its electricity.
It’s a pretty even match.

label: ZKN_MOON_240_000
text:
A famous potter lives with a Magby.
Apparently its soft flames produce fine works.

label: ZKN_MOON_241_000
text:
Most people raise it for its milk, but it’s quite
tough and strong, so it’s also well suited
for battle.

label: ZKN_MOON_242_000
text:
Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to
read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_278_000
text:
Fishermen keep an eye out for Wingull in the
sky, because wherever they’re circling, the
ocean is sure to be teeming with fish Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_279_000
text:
Gathering food is the work of young males.
They store food in their capacious beaks and
carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

label: ZKN_MOON_283_000
text:
When this Pokémon senses danger, a sweet
fluid oozes from the tip of its head. The taste
of it disgusts bird Pokémon.

label: ZKN_MOON_284_000
text:
Its wings and antennae don’t cope well with
moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to
dry off.

label: ZKN_MOON_296_000
text:
Their daily routine consists of training together
first thing in the morning, eating and napping in
the afternoon, and then more training afterward.

label: ZKN_MOON_297_000
text:
They love to compare their freakish strength—
strength enough to send a truck flying with a
single slap.

label: ZKN_MOON_299_000
text:
It uses powerful magnetism to drag its prey
toward it. It’s also been known to pull in metal,
which it collects and uses to protect itself.

label: ZKN_MOON_302_000
text:
This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes
begin to glow with a sinister shine, it’s believed
that Sableye will steal people’s spirits away.

label: ZKN_MOON_318_000
text:
If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they
rush to attack en masse. When alone, they’re
rather cowardly.

label: ZKN_MOON_319_000
text:
It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin
was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon
became a victim of overfishing.

label: ZKN_MOON_320_000
text:
It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from
the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of
Wishiwashi every day.

label: ZKN_MOON_321_000
text:
Its immense size is the reason for its popularity.
Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing
activity in various parts of the world.

label: ZKN_MOON_324_000
text:
If the fire burning within its shell goes out, it will
die. Those who wish to raise one in their home
must always keep something flammable at hand.

label: ZKN_MOON_327_000
text:
Each and every Spinda has a slightly different
configuration of spots. There are collectors who
enjoy the tiny differences in their spot patterns.

label: ZKN_MOON_328_000
text:
As it digs through the sand, its giant jaws
crush any rocks that obstruct its path. It builds
a funnel-shaped nest.

label: ZKN_MOON_329_000
text:
To help make its wings grow, it dissolves
quantities of prey in its digestive juices and
guzzles them down every day.

label: ZKN_MOON_330_000
text:
This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms
it creates and seldom appears where people
can see it.

label: ZKN_MOON_339_000
text:
Its slippery body is hard to grasp, so much so
that there are festivals where people compete
to see how many they can catch barehanded.

label: ZKN_MOON_340_000
text:
Sighting Whiscash leaping from the water
is believed to herald an earthquake.

label: ZKN_MOON_349_000
text:
Although unattractive and unpopular, this
Pokémon’s marvelous vitality has made it a
subject of research.

label: ZKN_MOON_350_000
text:
It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of
war, it shows itself, which soothes people’s
minds and hearts.

label: ZKN_MOON_351_000
text:
Its form changes on its own, due to its cells’
sensitive reactions to temperature and humidity.

label: ZKN_MOON_359_000
text:
Although it’s said to bring disaster, in actuality,
this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and
warns people of any crises that loom.

label: ZKN_MOON_361_000
text:
It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces
happily around, even in environments as cold as
-150 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_MOON_362_000
text:
Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the
cold air it exhales from its huge mouth. While
they’re in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.

label: ZKN_MOON_369_000
text:
It was fortuitously discovered during a deep sea
expedition. Its teeth have atrophied, so it now
survives on microscopic organisms it sucks up.

label: ZKN_MOON_370_000
text:
Loving couples have a soft spot for this
Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release
this Pokémon into their pools.

label: ZKN_MOON_371_000
text:
With its steel-hard stone head, it headbutts
indiscriminately. This is because of the stress
it feels at being unable to fly.

label: ZKN_MOON_372_000
text:
They lurk deep within caves—motionless,
neither eating nor drinking. Why they don’t die is
not known.

label: ZKN_MOON_373_000
text:
It flies around on its wings, which have grown in
at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames,
burning up the fields it passes over.

label: ZKN_MOON_374_000
text:
With magnetic traction, it pulls its opponents in
close. When they’re in range, it slashes them
with its rear claws.

label: ZKN_MOON_375_000
text:
It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues
Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

label: ZKN_MOON_376_000
text:
A linkage of two Metang, this Pokémon can
perform any calculation in a flash by utilizing
parallel processing in its four brains.

label: ZKN_MOON_408_000
text:
In rock layers where Cranidos fossils are found,
the fossilized trunks of trees snapped in two
are also often found.

label: ZKN_MOON_409_000
text:
Records exist of a revived fossil that evolved
into Rampardos. It proceeded to escape and
then destroy a skyscraper with a headbutt.

label: ZKN_MOON_410_000
text:
This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few
enemies would have been willing to square off
against its heavily armored face, so it’s thought.

label: ZKN_MOON_411_000
text:
It lived in the same environments as Rampardos.
Their fossils have been found together—
seemingly from after they’d fought to the finish.

label: ZKN_MOON_422_000
text:
Purple mucus sticks to the hands of anyone
who touches it. Take care, as the substance is
troublesome to wash off.

label: ZKN_MOON_423_000
text:
Plankton, invisible to the naked eye, is its main
food source. It comes onto the land periodically,
but the reason for this is not known.

label: ZKN_MOON_425_000
text:
If for some reason its body bursts, its soul spills
out with a screaming sound.

label: ZKN_MOON_426_000
text:
Even while under careful observation, large
flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably
disappear from view.

label: ZKN_MOON_429_000
text:
Mismagius have been known to cast spells to
make people fall in love, so some people search
for this Pokémon as if their life depended on it.

label: ZKN_MOON_430_000
text:
If its Murkrow cronies fail to catch food for it,
or if it feels they have betrayed it, it will hunt
them down wherever they are and punish them.

label: ZKN_MOON_438_000
text:
From its eyes, it can expel excess moisture from
its body. This liquid is similar in composition to
human sweat.

label: ZKN_MOON_440_000
text:
It’s too small to lay eggs yet. As a surrogate,
it searches out round white stones.

label: ZKN_MOON_443_000

radar, enabling it to probe the condition of its
battle opponents.

people who have auras resembling those

dumps and will stick close by its Trainer’s side.

become a trustworthy partner that will

Shellder converts into impregnable armor.
There is virtually no change in Slowpoke.

label: ZKN_MOON_088_001
text:
The crystals on Grimer’s body are lumps of
toxins. If one falls off, lethal poisons leak out.

label: ZKN_MOON_089_001
text:
While it’s unexpectedly quiet and friendly, if it’s
not fed any trash for a while, it will smash its
Trainer’s furnishings and eat up the fragments.

label: ZKN_MOON_094_001
text:
The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it.
It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps
a patient watch for its chance to attack.

label: ZKN_MOON_103_001
text:
As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its
reliance on psychic powers, while within it
awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

label: ZKN_MOON_105_001
text:
Its custom is to mourn its lost companions.
Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark
the graves of the Marowak.

label: ZKN_MOON_115_001
text:
Thanks to Mega Evolution, its child grows. But
as the child is good only at fighting and nothing
else, its mother feels uneasy about its future.

label: ZKN_MOON_127_001
text:
Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, its
wings become unusually developed. It flies
at speeds of approximately 30 mph.

label: ZKN_MOON_130_001
text:
It jets water from the orifices on its sides,
streaking above the water surface at
supersonic speed.

label: ZKN_MOON_142_001
text:
When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious
than ever before. Some say that’s because its
excess of power is causing it pain.

label: ZKN_MOON_212_001
text:
Due to the effects of Mega Evolution, its pincers
have taken on a more diabolical form, ripping
anything they pinch to shreds.

label: ZKN_MOON_302_001
text:
Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can’t change
direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack
from behind.

label: ZKN_MOON_319_001
text:
As a consequence of Mega Evolution, its
combative instincts exploded. The yellow marks
it bears are scars from a long history of battles.

label: ZKN_MOON_351_001
text:
This is Castform’s form when basking in fair
weather. Its body is warm and toasty.

label: ZKN_MOON_351_002
text:
This is Castform’s form during a downpour of
rain. Its body retains moisture and gets slippery.

label: ZKN_MOON_351_003
text:
This is Castform’s form when caught in a
hailstorm. Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

label: ZKN_MOON_359_001
text:
As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur
bristles. What you see on its back are not true
wings, and this Pokémon isn’t able to fly.

label: ZKN_MOON_362_001
text:
It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them
instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it’s unable
to eat them.

label: ZKN_MOON_373_001
text:
Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it may
even turn on the Trainer who raised it. It’s been
dubbed “the blood-soaked crescent.”

label: ZKN_MOON_376_001
text:
Mega Evolution stimulated its brain. It emerged
as a ruthless Pokémon that will clutch at any
means of ensuring its victories.

label: ZKN_MOON_422_001
text:
The difference in color from one Shellos to
another seems to be a result of their diet. No
large changes can be seen in their capabilities.

label: ZKN_MOON_423_001
text:
Experiments are being conducted to discover
what happens when a Gastrodon is raised in a
location other than the sea where it was born.

label: ZKN_MOON_445_001
text:
Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it
mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and
slices the ground to pieces.

label: ZKN_MOON_448_001
text:
It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing
its mental energies. Its fighting style can be
summed up in a single word: heartless.

label: ZKN_MOON_718_001
text:
This is Zygarde’s form when about 10% of its
cells have been gathered. It runs across the
land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

label: ZKN_MOON_718_002
text:
This is Zygarde’s form when about 10% of its
cells have been gathered. It runs across the
land at speeds greater than 60 mph.

label: ZKN_MOON_718_003
text:
It’s thought to be monitoring the ecosystem.
There are rumors that even greater power lies
hidden within it.

label: ZKN_MOON_718_004
text:
This is Zygarde’s 100% form. It has enough
power to overwhelm even Xerneas or Yveltal.

label: ZKN_MOON_741_001
text:
It creates an electric charge by rubbing its
feathers together. It dances over to its enemies
and delivers shocking electrical punches.

label: ZKN_MOON_741_002
text:
This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar.
Its enemies’ hearts melt at the sight of its
gently swaying hips.

label: ZKN_MOON_741_003
text:
It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing.
From their malice, it draws power with which to
curse its enemies.

label: ZKN_MOON_745_001
text:
It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands
the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt,
crushing their bones with its rocky mane.

label: ZKN_MOON_746_001
text:
At their appearance, even Gyarados will flee.
When they team up to use Water Gun, its power
exceeds that of Hydro Pump.
